findings.evidence: The roadmap at ClassicalGroups/README.md:182 requires “a nondegenerate symmetric form `V ≅ V*`” and says to state invariance as equivariance; `rg` finds only the scalar theorem at lines 61–79 and no `LinearEquiv`, representation isomorphism, or nondegeneracy declaration in this file.
findings.fix: Define the dot-product linear equivalence `(Fin n → k) ≃ₗ[k] Module.Dual k (Fin n → k)` and prove it intertwines `stdOrthogonalRep` with `stdOrthogonalDualRep` (or provide the equivalent `FDRep` isomorphism).
findings.issue: `stdOrthogonalRep_dotProduct` only states equality of scalar dot products; it does not construct the required equivariant nondegenerate symmetric pairing `V ≅ V*`, so the advertised collapse of the standard representation with its dual is absent.

summary: The PR proves scalar pairing invariance but omits the nondegenerate equivariant identification required by the roadmap, so it does not formalize the distinguishing orthogonal invariant it claims to supply.
